title: Coefficients and geometric categories
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $q=p^r$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, a prime
$\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi$,
and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
A geometric scheme is a scheme [def-pc-scheme] separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] over $k$; its structure
map is $a_X:X\to s$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Maps between geometric schemes are $k$-maps [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and
unsubscripted products are fibre products over $s$ [def-pc-fibre-product].
Dimension is the supremum of lengths of chains of irreducible closed
subsets [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Reduction means quotienting the structure sheaf by its nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction].
A universal homeomorphism is a morphism inducing a homeomorphism after
every base change [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. These terms are used only in the final reduction steps.
Write $D(X,A)$ for the ordinary derived category of sheaves of $A$-modules
on $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ for its bounded
constructible objects [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] of finite Tor-amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. This definition uses the latter general ringed-site Tor-amplitude predicate for every scheme $X$; on schemes where $\ell$ is invertible it is the finite-coefficient subcategory of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].
On geometric schemes $X$, the subcategories $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ are fixed as part of the coefficient data, subject to the following requirements. They are full triangulated subcategories [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] of $D(X,A)$, closed under isomorphisms. For every $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between geometric schemes,
$$
f^*\bigl(D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)\bigr)\subseteq D^b_{ctf}(X,A).
$$
For every compactifiable such $f$ [def-asd-compactifiable], choose a compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$, with $\overline X$ geometric, $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ an open $k$-immersion and $\bar f:\overline X\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism, and use the chosen-compactification functor
$$
Rf_!:=R\bar f_*\,j_!:D(X,A)\longrightarrow D(Y,A)
$$
of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Require
$$
Rf_!\bigl(D^b_{ctf}(X,A)\bigr)\subseteq D^b_{ctf}(Y,A).
$$
Here $f^*=Lf^*$ and $R\bar f_*$ are the ordinary, uncompleted derived inverse and direct images of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], for the constant coefficient sheaves. Extension by zero $j_!$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero] is applied termwise to complexes, using its exactness [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact] and the induced derived functor [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. The chosen composite is defined on $D(X,A)$; compactification independence is used only on the bounded-below étale-origin subcategory specified by [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], not on the entire unbounded category. Triangulatedness, closure under isomorphisms, and the two preservation conditions are requirements on this geometric coefficient package. The definitions of $D(X,A)$ and of bounded constructible finite-Tor objects remain available for arbitrary schemes, but these requirements quantify only over geometric schemes and $k$-maps. This corrects the false all-scheme stability requirement of the imported sketch.
For a commutative ring $R$,
$\Perf(R)\subset D(R)$ consists of objects represented by bounded complexes
of finitely generated projective $R$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex].

split_report.summary: Repaired returned E7/E2: the retrocompact constructibility definition makes the imported all-scheme compact-support stability false. Restrict the fixed-data stability requirements to geometric schemes and k-maps, recording the polynomial-ring counterexample and all ten direct citer checks in report.md. Ordinary D(X,A) and the general Tor predicate remain defined on arbitrary schemes. Choose a compactification for each compactifiable geometric map and use its actual composite R fbar_* j_!; do not require compactification independence on the entire unbounded category. This respects the current def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed restriction to bounded-below etale-origin complexes. Restore omitted lean_audit metadata, correct logged search dates, and flag the stale perfect-complex tag and historical unit for maintenance. No new nodes or proof steps. In this continuation, reread the returned repair against the current shared statements and sources, repeated the four corrected-scope searches, and made the geometric k-scheme compactification domain explicit.
split_report.blueprint: All paragraphs of main-20261015 sk-d-setup/_section.md, order 2610, are realized: coefficient datum, geometric schemes/maps/products, dimension/reduction/universal homeomorphisms, ordinary pro-etale D(X,A), bounded constructible finite Tor objects, corrected geometric-scope stability requirements, and Perf(R). The source error in the all-scheme requirement is explicitly recorded rather than retained as an impossible fixed-data axiom. The definition unit has no proof steps; only its realization fields are changed.

repair.return: E7/E2 at returned head c6ead0af8d: impossible all-scheme Rf_! stability, missing Source error, non-qcqs pullback scope, citer recheck; stale perfect-complex tag and unit text.
repair.source_error: For R=k[x_1,x_2,...] and m=(x_1,x_2,...), the closed immersion i:Spec(R/m)->Spec(R) is proper and finite type. With A=Z/ell, H^0(Ri_!A)=i_*A is not constructible. A constructible stratum containing m also contains the prime (x_1,...,x_N) for some finite N; flat going-down prevents a weakly etale local trivialization of the nonzero stalk at m with support only at m. Thus the literal all-scheme fixed-data requirement is inconsistent.
repair.decision: Require stability only on separated finite-type k-schemes and k-maps, matching GeometricCoefficients and the (i)/(iv) domain of thm-sf-ctf-stability. No non-qcqs preservation statement remains. The general ambient categories are still defined.
repair.scope: For each compactifiable geometric map use a chosen compactification composite; independence outside the etale-origin domain is not asserted. All ten direct citers retain the notions they use; generic ambient-operation uses require their own expressly supplied functors and adjunctions.
repair.maintenance: def-pc-perfect-ring-complex source should be Stacks Tag 0657, more-algebra-definition-perfect, not 0A1U. The unit record still cites the older master snapshot. These maintainer-owned texts are reported, not edited.

The closed immersion Spec k -> Spec k[x1,x2,...] at m is finite type and proper (Stacks morphisms lemma-immersion-locally-finite-type and lemma-closed-immersion-proper), so it is compactifiable with j=id. Its Ri_!A = i_*A is not constructible: a constructible set (Stacks 005G) containing m also contains p_N=(x1..xN), and going-down along a flat cover contradicts local constancy. The repair restricts the pullback and Rf_! stability requirements to geometric schemes and k-maps. Compactification independence is claimed only on the etale-origin subcategory. j_! is applied termwise through exactness and Stacks 015F (read). Requiring the compactification to be geometric loses no case. Edge cases checked: a point with f=id, the empty scheme, open and proper maps, and A=Z/l^2 with M=Z/l, which has infinite Tor amplitude and is excluded, so the finite-Tor condition is not vacuous. The statement dependencies are acyclic. There are no new nodes, no tool uses and no SGA citations. No citer breaks: each supplies its own operation data outside the geometric case. No fixes.
